summary:
The hand-written sections now describe revision r3. The strict build passes with no warning, `check.mjs` ends with "All checks passed", and a fresh browser profile shows "50 / 52 answered" at 1440 px and 400 px with no console error and no sideways scroll.

One instruction is only partly met: the source of `15-your-answers.html` is longer than in r2. It has 1,761 lines against 1,649, and 8,111 reader words against 7,223 (+888). The rendered section is shorter: 14,231 px against 15,508 px at 1440 px, and 25,327 px against 27,763 px at 400 px. That is because I put two reference tables that r3 did not change into closed `<details>` elements (the 17-row compatibility table and the 9-row "differs" table). With both open, the height equals r2 (15,529 px against 15,508 px). The new words are in three parts: "What this revision holds" (+298), the rules and the two facts (+204), and "How the answers fit together" (+282). I did not cut the reference parts, because the task says to keep them.

Skills loaded after `git remote -v` (origin is github.com/ariakit/visonaut): `ariakit-general-workflow`, `ariakit-general-markdown`. No visonaut-specific skill is installed.

The new entry point has one code example for D-OPS-04, which is not in section 35:

```ts
// packages/security/src/oidc.ts:171 and :194, inside the file check (lines 157 to 206).
requireEqual(file.sha, sha(configuration.callerWorkflowBlobSha), "rest.caller_workflow_blob");
requireEqual(isTrustedWorkflowBlob(file.sha, configuration), true, "rest.direct_workflow_blob");
```

I added no row to the "differs" table. D-WORK-04 (`approve-run`) and D-RES-05 (`stored-name`) were the recommended options in r2, and D-RES-06 had no recommended option.

Scratch files (scripts, before-copies, pictures, logs) are in /Users/diegohaz/.claude/jobs/f65a6229/tmp/round3/sections/editor/.

Only the rendered height is lower, because two unchanged reference tables are collapsed. Parity in words needs a cut of reference content (for example the JSON example of the title, the "What moves" table of D-CODE-04, or the r1 output of the calculator). I did not cut it, because the task says to keep the reference parts. The coordinator must decide.

Collapsing the compatibility table and the "differs" table is my editorial choice. Their content is unchanged, except the D-DATA-04 and D-RES-02 rows of the second. If the maintainer wants them open, remove the two `<details>` wrappers.

"Each later CLI release is then a workflow edit with no pin cutover, which is cheaper for Ariakit" follows from the option text of D-OPS-04 ("nothing for each kind of workflow edit") and from the data-02 doubt ("If D-OPS-04 removes the pins, it gets cheaper"). Nobody verified that no other pinned value of the service depends on the CLI version.
"Rule 2 has 'only used internally by Ariakit itself' as its reason, so it ends with the first other customer" is my inference from the two quotes. No lane stated it.

Scale "touches" D-RUN-02 and D-WORK-04: the first comes from the data-02 lane (the review read must work page by page). The second is my reading of section 60 (18 statements for 246 targets and for 3,832). The run approval still writes one row for each target.

30-access-trust.html: "with its options 1 to 3 no file of Ariakit is pinned". For option 2 this rests on the option text "No consumer file has a pin". That option still compares ci.yml with the file on main for the no-visual report, which is a check and not a pin.

The row "Deletion" of the fit table keeps the r2 order "D-DATA-02, then the retention tests, then D-DATA-04". Step 3 of the order demo puts the retention tests of D-DATA-01 before D-DATA-02 is settled. This mismatch is from r2 and I did not resolve it.
The answers table gives the D-OPS-04 answer in 5 short sentences, not 4, so that each of the four questions of the note has an answer. The D-DATA-02 answer has one more sentence about the 14 limits.

Sentences that say "your rule says that D1 writes must not increase" stay in the r2 notes of sections 35 and 40, in section 60 (line 1579), in the D-OPS-04 part (line 1188), and in the rationales of D-OPS-01, D-OPS-05, and D-DATA-01. Each is about a write that repeats, so none is false under the clarified rule. I left them.
D-RES-06 context still says "This decision is new in revision r2". I read it as history and did not change it.
